sections.title: Complete café interactions
sections.content: A basic café interaction can include a greeting, an order, a question about the order, and a closing. Use the language from the previous lessons together.

items.english: Good afternoon. What would you like?

items.spanish: Quiero un café y un sándwich, por favor.
items.english: I would like a coffee and a sandwich, please.

sections.content: At A1 level, a short predictable exchange is enough: greeting → order → anything else → closing.
